name: Ayesha Rehman
bio: Trained at NCA Lahore and worked six years in Dubai hospitality design before founding Woodex in 2014. Leads concept, space planning and material direction on every project.
quote: A plan that works at 8am on a Tuesday will still work at 8pm on a Saturday.

name: Bilal Anwar
bio: Twenty-two years on commercial sites across Pakistan and the Gulf. Owns programmes, procurement and the line-item BOQs that keep our variance under three percent.
quote: A budget is a promise. Write it in line items or do not write it at all.

name: Hassan Qureshi
bio: Specialises in layered residential and hospitality lighting. Writes the colour-temperature discipline that stops a dining room feeling like a pharmacy after dark.
quote: If you can see the fitting, we have usually specified the wrong one.

name: Imran Sheikh
bio: Runs supervision across all live sites and wrote the twenty-two-item Friday inspection routine that keeps programmes from slipping in week fourteen.
quote: The Friday report exists so nobody is surprised in week eighteen.

name: Zoya Malik
bio: Leads residential commissions and the joinery detail library. Known for wardrobes that hold a tolerance of 1.5 mm across a four-metre run.
quote: Detail is not decoration. Detail is the reason a door closes quietly.

name: Usman Tariq
bio: Designs flagship stores and franchise rollout packs. Has delivered thirty-eight outlets in nine cities from a single documented standard.
quote: Store two should be cheaper than store one. If it is not, the manual is wrong.

name: Fatima Noor
bio: Runs the visualisation studio. Keeps the render model and the workshop model identical so approvals mean something on site.
quote: One model, two outputs. That is the only way an approval is honest.

name: Kashif Mehmood
bio: Eighteen years in panel processing, veneer pressing and spray finishing. Manages forty-one craftsmen and the queue that decides every delivery date.
quote: The drawing is a request. The jig is a guarantee.
